module.purpose: Implements React DOM event listener wrappers and dispatch logic, mapping DOM events to priorities and handling hydration blocking and continuous event replay.
module.summary: This module is the core of React DOM's event system bindings. It creates listener wrappers that bind dispatch functions to a container and event flags, selecting discrete, continuous, or default priority. The main dispatch function checks whether an event is blocked by pending hydration (Suspense, Activity, or dehydrated HostRoot), queues continuous events for replay, and otherwise dispatches through the plugin event system. A helper maps DOM event names to React event priorities using scheduler priority when inside message events.
module.businessContext: Part of React's internal DOM renderer. Correct event dispatch and hydration replay are critical; failure breaks interactivity or causes hydration mismatches.
functions: setEnabled (~L74-76): Toggle whether event dispatching is enabled.

createEventListenerWrapper (~L82-93): Bind dispatchEvent to container and flags.

getEventPriority (~L299-343): Map DOM event name to React event priority.

units.name: createEventListenerWrapperWithPriority

detail.name: createEventListenerWrapperWithPriority
detail.signature: function createEventListenerWrapperWithPriority(targetContainer: EventTarget, domEventName: DOMEventName, eventSystemFlags: EventSystemFlags): Function
preconditions: domEventName must be a valid DOM event name recognised by getEventPriority.
targetContainer must be a valid EventTarget capable of receiving DOM events.
eventSystemFlags must be a valid bitmask of React event system flags.
postconditions: The returned Function has its first three parameters (domEventName, eventSystemFlags, targetContainer) pre-bound to the values passed into this call.
The returned Function, when invoked, will dispatch the event using a priority-specific dispatcher (dispatchDiscreteEvent, dispatchContinuousEvent, or dispatchEvent).
invariants: getEventPriority is used consistently to determine event priority for all events handled via this factory.
The mapping of DiscreteEventPriority to dispatchDiscreteEvent, ContinuousEventPriority to dispatchContinuousEvent, and DefaultEventPriority (or fallback) to dispatchEvent is invariant.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Accepts an EventTarget (targetContainer), a DOMEventName string, and an integer eventSystemFlags bitmask. Returns a Function whose leading parameters are bound so it can be directly attached as a DOM event listener.
detail.summary: Selects and binds the appropriate React event-dispatching function (discrete, continuous, or default) based on the priority of domEventName, returning a Function ready to be used as an event listener.
